added.summary: A core select bound by value: literal options under one level of optgroups (disabled options and groups skipped), keyboard, d-pad and pointer picking, typeahead, Escape or B closing, the focus returned to the trigger. A bound list is items={…} values={…}. Parts Dropdown.trigger, .list, .group, .option.

HTML's dialog, two-way open: modal (a scrim taking every press, the focus moved in, trapped and returned, Escape, B or the scrim closing it) or in place (Back closes it while the focus is inside). ui.DialogDesc and Ui::open_dialog for Rust.
A disclosure, two-way open: the summary row toggles it by press, Enter, Space or A; the content is built only while open. Parts Details.root, .summary[open], .content.
HTML's meter beside <progress>: value, min, max, low, high, optimum; the fill is dressed Meter.fill[region=optimum|suboptimum|poor] by HTML's region rules.

fixed.member: UI documents: popovers and dialogs in retained documents
fixed.summary: A retained layer rewritten in its own slot is no longer renamed `<id>~1` with a duplicate-layer warning; Back reaches the element owning the topmost scope or holding the focus; a press on a disabled option inside an open dropdown no longer closes it.
